facts: The first Taipei main building was completed in August 1965. Later expansions altered exhibition space and the approach forecourt.

record: 故宮文物月刊 roof-pavilion study
facts: Documents five pavilion structures on the Wai-shuang-hsi main building and describes the visitor spaces they served.

record: 故宮文物月刊 museum grounds article by 王聖涵
facts: Architect Huang Baoyu’s approach aligned the lower public gate, stairs and main building axes. The design combines modern concrete and classical roof forms.
